evidence.title: Infosys expands Mohali centre with Rs 290-crore investment, to add 3,000 seats - The Economic Times
evidence.snippet:
# Infosys expands Mohali centre with Rs 290-crore investment, to add 3,000 seats
### Synopsis
Infosys has started expanding its Mohali Development Centre with a Rs 290 crore investment.
The new facility will include a software development block and space for about 3,000 employees.
The project aims to strengthen Infosys’ presence in North India and support AI-led solutions, cloud services and digital transformation for global clients.
...
Software services company Infosys on Thursday announced the expansion of its Mohali Development Centre (DC), with a formal groundbreaking ceremony held on the campus.
The software major has invested about Rs 290 crore in setting up the new facility, which will strengthen its presence in North India.
...
As part of the expansion, Infosys will develop a new software development block along with supporting facilities.
The project will have a built-up area of about 350,000 sq ft and will accommodate around 3,000 employees, enhancing the company’s ability to design, co-create and deploy AI-led solutions at enterprise scale.
Infosys’ current operations in Mohali employ close to 1,000 people and deliver advanced digital services to global clients across sectors such as banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI), retail and healthcare.
The expanded campus will further strengthen the company’s capabilities in cloud, AI, application development and digital transformation.

evidence.snippet:
# Asian Paints to invest Rs 960 cr to expand Gujarat unit
Asian Paints Ltd will invest Rs 960 crore to expand the manufacturing capacity of its facility situated at Ankleshwar in Gujarat.
Asian Paints Ltd on Monday said it will invest Rs 960 crore to expand the manufacturing capacity of its facility situated at Ankleshwar in Gujarat.
The company has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Government of Gujarat commencing the proposed expansion of manufacturing capacity of paint from 1.3 lakh KL to 2.5 lakh KL and resins and emulsions from 32,000 MT to 85,000 MT, Asian Paints said in a regulatory filing.
The expansion is to be completed in the next 2-3 years at a total investment of Rs 960 crore approximately on plant and machinery at the current prevailing prices, it added.
"This expansion will be carried out on the existing land owned by the company," the filing said.

Asian Paints on Thursday announced Rs 2,100 crore of phased investment to set up a new plant to produce vinyl acetate ethylene emulsion (VAE) and vinyl acetate monomer (VAM) in the country.
The company also announced another Rs 550 crore of investment to set up a white cement plant in the UAE in partnership with two local firms there.
The board has approved setting up of a manufacturing facility for VAE and VAM in the country.
The company will invest around Rs 2,100 crore in the plant over the next three years, which includes the cost of land, the company informed the stock exchanges without giving other details like the location of the plant among others.
The statement also said the plan is subject to entering into definitive agreements, including technology licence agreement from the US-based Kellogg Brown & Root, for manufacturing VAM and VAE and obtaining the necessary regulatory and other approvals.
The proposed plant will have an installed capacity of 1 lakh tonne per annum .

ndia’s largest beauty retailer FSN E-Commerce Ventures Ltd., which owns the Nykaa platform, is expanding overseas business operations in an attempt to take on global cosmetics giants outside of its home market.

evidence.title: Nykaa Reports 28% Revenue Growth as Profits Triple - Global Cosmetics News
evidence.snippet:

...

Nykaa also announced an agreement to acquire an 82 percent stake in premium cosmetics brand Simply Nam, subject to regulatory approvals, strengthening its professional make-up portfolio.
**THE WHY?** The results highlight the continued expansion of India’s cosmetics market and the growing importance of integrated retail, distribution and brand ownership strategies.
Nykaa’s investment in physical stores, B2B distribution and premium cosmetics acquisitions strengthens its competitive position while creating additional market access opportunities for international manufacturers and emerging Indian brands.

# Bajaj Finserv gets nod for MF biz, to start wealth mgmt soon
MUMBAI: Financial services major, Bajaj Finserv, plans to launch its wealth management subsidiary-- Bajaj Financial Solutions--in the next 6-8-weeks and has also received regulatory approval to launch mutual funds business, a top company official said.
"We plan to launch our wealth management business in the next 6-8-weeks.
We have already gone live with BSE connectivity and will go live with NSE soon," Bajaj Finserv's Managing Director, Sanjiv Bajaj, told PTI here today.
A team has already been put in place for the business which will be headed by Arpit Aggarwal as CEO, he said.
Bajaj Finserv also plans to launch its infrastructure financing business soon, Bajaj said.
Anand Gore will be the CEO of this business which will focus on core infrastructure projects such as roads, telecom and power, Bajaj said.
...

The company has also received approval last week to launch mutual funds business which will be done in partnership with Allianz, Bajaj said.
"We are fine-tuning details regarding this business," he added.

evidence.title: Dixon Technologies to invest ₹700 crore in Tirupati in AP
evidence.snippet:
## Minister Lokesh thanked Dixon for expansion plans at Kopparthy and Tirupati for the Dixon Tirupati hub, India’s largest LED TV plant
### By G Naga Sridhar
Dixon Technologies is planning to invest ₹700 crore in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh.
This was disclosed at a meeting of Minister for Education, IT & Electronics, Nara Lokesh with Dixon Technologies President & Chief Operating Officer Pankaj Sharma here on Friday at the 31st CII Partnership Summit.
Pankaj Sharma expressed willingness to make a fresh investment of ₹700 crore at Tirupati - EMC-II.
This investment will create 2,300 job opportunities for the youth of the State.
Minister Lokesh thanked Dixon for formulating expansion plans at Kopparthy and Tirupati for the Dixon Tirupati hub, which is the largest LED TV plant in India.
He invited Dixon to set up a laptop, desktop and server manufacturing unit in AP under the Dixon-Inventec JV.
Speaking on the occasion, Dixon President Pankaj Sharma said Dixon Technologies has had India’s largest LED TV plant (Xiaomi and other brands) with an in-house LCM line in Tirupati since 2018.
He said AIL Dixon (CP Plus) is being expanded at Kopparthy in Kadapa district with ₹450 crore, which will create 7,000 job opportunities.

evidence.title: Dixon Technologies to invest ₹700 crore in Tirupati in AP
evidence.snippet:
## Minister Lokesh thanked Dixon for expansion plans at Kopparthy and Tirupati for the Dixon Tirupati hub, India’s largest LED TV plant
### By G Naga Sridhar
Dixon Technologies is planning to invest ₹700 crore in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh.
This was disclosed at a meeting of Minister for Education, IT & Electronics, Nara Lokesh with Dixon Technologies President & Chief Operating Officer Pankaj Sharma here on Friday at the 31st CII Partnership Summit.
Pankaj Sharma expressed willingness to make a fresh investment of ₹700 crore at Tirupati - EMC-II.
This investment will create 2,300 job opportunities for the youth of the State.

He said AIL Dixon (CP Plus) is being expanded at Kopparthy in Kadapa district with ₹450 crore, which will create 7,000 job opportunities.

evidence.title: Shreeji Translogistics promoter group member acquires 0.04% stake

evidence.snippet:
# Shreeji Translogistics promoter group acquires 0.04% shares
Shreeji Translogistics Limited has filed a disclosure under SEBI regulations regarding a share acquisition by a member of its promoter group.
Mrs. Chandrika Rajnikant Shah, acting in concert with other promoter group members, purchased **26,283 shares**, representing **0.04%** of the total share capital.
This transaction occurred on **November 13, 2026**, and the details have been submitted to the BSE Limited.
...
## Details of the Transaction
Mrs. Chandrika Rajnikant Shah, identified as a member of the Promoter Group, has acquired **26,283 shares** of Shreeji Translogistics Limited.
This acquisition represents **0.04%** of the total share capital.
The transaction took place on **November 13, 2026**, through the Open Market mode.
Following this acquisition, the total holding of Mrs. Chandrika Rajnikant Shah and persons acting in concert with her in Shreeji Translogistics Limited stands at **2,34,915 shares**, which constitutes **0.34%** of the company’s total share and voting capital.
The equity share capital of the company before and after the said acquisition remains unchanged at **Rs. 13,97,67,000/-**.

Shreeji Translogistics की प्रमोटर समूह सदस्य Chandrika Rajnikant Shah ने 28,994 शेयर खरीदे। BSE फाइलिंग के मुताबिक, उनकी व्यक्तिगत हिस्सेदारी बढ़कर 0.28% हुई।
PSU ExpressThu, 12 Nov 2026, 10:08 am IST
Shreeji Translogistics: प्रमोटर समूह की सदस्य ने खरीदे 28,994 शेयर, हिस्सेदारी 0.28%
**Shreeji Translogistics Ltd** ने 12 नवंबर 2026 को BSE को दी गई फाइलिंग में बताया कि प्रमोटर समूह की सदस्य Chandrika Rajnikant Shah ने 11 नवंबर 2026 को कंपनी के **28,994 शेयर** खरीदे। खुले बाजार से हुई इस खरीद के बाद उनकी व्यक्तिगत हिस्सेदारी 0.24% से बढ़कर **0.28%** हो गई। खरीदे गए शेयर कंपनी की कुल शेयर पूंजी के 0.04% के बराबर हैं।

...

...
अधिग्रहण का तरीका खुले बाजार की खरीद बताया गया है। उपलब्ध खुलासे में प्रति शेयर खरीद मूल्य या इस लेनदेन पर खर्च की गई कुल राशि नहीं दी गई है। इस कारण शेयरों की संख्या और हिस्सेदारी में बदलाव की जानकारी उपलब्ध है, लेकिन खरीद का वित्तीय मूल्य नहीं बताया गया है।

evidence.snippet:
# Shreeji Translogistics promoter group acquires 0.04% shares
Shreeji Translogistics Limited has filed a disclosure under SEBI regulations regarding a share acquisition by a member of its promoter group.
Mrs. Chandrika Rajnikant Shah, acting in concert with other promoter group members, purchased **26,283 shares**, representing **0.04%** of the total share capital.
This transaction occurred on **November 13, 2026**, and the details have been submitted to the BSE Limited.
...
## Details of the Transaction
Mrs. Chandrika Rajnikant Shah, identified as a member of the Promoter Group, has acquired **26,283 shares** of Shreeji Translogistics Limited.
This acquisition represents **0.04%** of the total share capital.
The transaction took place on **November 13, 2026**, through the Open Market mode.
Following this acquisition, the total holding of Mrs. Chandrika Rajnikant Shah and persons acting in concert with her in Shreeji Translogistics Limited stands at **2,34,915 shares**, which constitutes **0.34%** of the company’s total share and voting capital.
The equity share capital of the company before and after the said acquisition remains unchanged at **Rs. 13,97,67,000/-**.
